entry.name: useKadunce
entry.label: Allow Tettegouche to open inside Kadunce's Spread when available

entry.name: offerRecent
entry.label: Show recent files and applications in Search before anything is typed

entry.name: offerNotes
entry.label: Show Notes in Search before anything is typed, when Gooseberry is installed

entry.name: showNotesPill
entry.label: Show the Notes pill on Search's first screen, while Notes is offered; notes still show among the results

entry.name: showAmbient
entry.label: Show Ambient's islands beside the launcher in the panel

entry.name: showQuickNote
entry.label: Show the quick note island beside the launcher, while Gooseberry is installed and the islands are shown

entry.name: launcherPlacement
entry.label: Where the launcher's dot sits in the widget: start, before the islands; end, after them; or none, for a widget that shows islands alone

entry.name: ambientShows
entry.label: Which islands the widget shows: all, media alone, or others, every island but media

entry.name: ambientAlign
entry.label: Where the islands gather in the widget's width: center, start or end

entry.name: islandOutline
entry.label: Draw each island as a faint pill; off, the islands are words and glyphs on the panel alone

entry.name: islandSpacing
entry.label: Room between islands, in pixels, from 4 to 32; unset or 0, 8 between pills and 24 without an outline

entry.name: pearlLook
entry.label: How the launcher's dot is drawn: pearl, the Tette Dot; or magnifier, a magnifying-glass mark in its place

entry.name: animateIndicator
entry.label: Animate the panel indicator when Tettegouche opens
